Alice Chen: Quick async standup — TL;DR: working on v2 routing canary + a tiny schema question that needs a quick decision.

• Yesterday: landed model-routing tests for v2, added fallback policy for small GPUs, and smoke on Dedicated infra.
• Blockers: seeing ~2% long-tail mismatch on JSON output shape for tool-calls — need agreement on whether to add a small optional wrapper or change root keys.
• Today: finish canary rollout, push PR updates, and triage any post-canary regressions. Pinging @Carolina and @Ben for spec + tokenizer sanity check. /cc @Frank for canary timing.

Ben O'Rourke: Can take the tokenizer angle. If you can paste a couple failing examples here I can repro locally. Also will try to review PR #842 (https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/842) today — marking it canary-ready if green.

Carolina Ruiz: Noted. From a contract perspective I prefer additive optional fields rather than changing existing root keys. Suggest adding an optional `meta.trace_id` instead of moving fields. I can draft a tiny spec patch and push by EOD.

Gina (PM): I agree with additive-first approach. We should freeze any contract fields that affect SDK users before the canary. Canary target: tomorrow AM PST — can we ship with `meta.trace_id` as opt-in? If yes, treat as P0 for release. :thumbsup:

Frank Li: deploy-bot has the canary queued. I can nudge it earlier if we need more runway. Reminder: tag PRs with `canary-ready` and include a short rollback note in the PR description.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: service=runtime, model=v2-router, start=1976546800, duration=30m. Status: queued.

Alice Chen: I'll update PR to add `meta.trace_id` optional field and leave backward-compatible output. Example of intended shape: 
```
{"id":"abc123","output":{"text":"..."}}
=>
{"id":"abc123","meta":{"trace_id":"rwd-9876"},"output":{"text":"..."}}
```
Ben — sending failing logs to your DM now. Will add `canary-ready` tag after tests pass.

Ben O'Rourke: Got the logs, thanks. If tokenizer padding is the culprit I'll post a quick patch to normalize tokens before postprocessing. Reviewing PR now.

Carolina Ruiz: Draft spec pushed to https://redwood.internal/specs/trace-meta (private). Added example vectors and a short migration note. Feedback welcome.

Gina (PM): Awesome. On prioritization: routing perf fixes = P0, schema opt-in + canary = P0 for this release, UX microcopy tweaks = P2. I'll update the roadmap doc and notify sales about the canary window.

Alice Chen: Thanks team — will update the PR and follow up once canary starts. If anyone wants a quick sync call before rollout, I can be available in 30.
